correctness.rationale: The proof combines the standard normal-cyclic-Sylow formula with divisibility forced by the two subgroups H and P×C_H(P). After reducing by gcd(ψ(H),ψ(C_H(P))), one divisor is bounded by ψ(P)-|P| while simultaneously differing by a positive multiple of ψ(P), which is impossible because gcd(ψ(P),|P|)=1.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2020/2021 source states the square-free-order case as an open problem after only a restricted ZM-group theorem and finite computation; the 2023 follow-up still describes nonabelian ψ-divisibility as open. Targeted searches found no normal-cyclic-Sylow obstruction or Z-group classification, and no overlapping SCOPE record was found.

value.rationale: The result gives a structural obstruction for all finite groups with a noncentral normal cyclic Sylow subgroup, classifies ψ-divisible Z-groups, and settles the published square-free-order open problem theoretically rather than up to a finite computational range.
